description.purpose: Read the value a path of fields reaches from an individual.
description.returns: A plain value with whether it is the declared default; a value depending on the world state with its state variables and current numbers; an individual by its handle.
description.use_when: Reading one value without describing the whole individual.

handle.description: The individual's handle, exactly as a tool's answer gave it, written '<Kind>#<n>'.

path.description: Field names separated by dots, written '<field>.<field>'.
